expanded_title: KK at It Again: Pocket Kings vs. Pocket Jacks vs. Pocket Eights on the Palace Felt
expanded_deck: A three-way pocket-pair collision on the maroon Palace Poker felt — Pocket Kings up against Pocket Jacks and Pocket Eights with a pile of red, green, and blue chips in the middle.
expanded_body:
Originally posted April 28, 2026.

Pocket Kings at it again — this time in a three-way pocket-pair collision on the maroon Palace Poker felt: KK vs. JJ vs. 88.

When three players wake up with wired pairs in the same hand and the chips go flying into the middle (captured in the hand-highlight reel on Facebook at https://www.facebook.com/reel/3148062308729546/), all you can do is table the cowboys and sweat the runout across the Palace felt.

— Sham
author: Shomari Williams
